ei.title: Importance of Asking Questions in Education
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Society makes a pedagogical mistake when it emphasizes obtaining the so-called "right answer" rather than asking the "right" question, or at least, a good question. The so-called "good student" is viewed as the one who rapidly provides the right answers to questions teachers ask. On this view, the expert in a given field unfortunately becomes an extension of the so-called "expert student" — the one who knows and can quickly spit back a lot of information. As John Dewey believed, how one thinks about issues often is more important and consequential in life than exactly what one thinks. Schools should teach students how to ask important questions (questions that are worth answering and that are interesting) and reduce their emphasis on rote learning of facts. And they need to reorient their emphases in diverse domains, not just in the arts. Contemporary creativity research embraces a wide variety of distinct domains, from science to engineering to business to architectural design to the arts to athletics, all of which are ready for creative investigation.

As John Dewey believed, how one thinks about issues often is more (C)[important / trivial] and consequential in life than exactly what one thinks. Schools should teach students how to ask important questions (questions that are worth answering and that are interesting) and reduce their emphasis on rote learning of facts. And they need to reorient their emphases in diverse domains, not just in the arts. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

❌ ④ asking/trivial: 두 단어 모두 원문과 불일치

det.analysis:
① pedagogical: 교육적 실수 → 적절

④ extension: 전문가가 모범 학생의 연장선이 된다 → 적절

det.analysis:
① important: 생각하는 방식이 더 중요하다 → 적절

③ reduce: 암기 학습 강조를 줄여야 한다 → 적절
④ creative: '창의적' 학습이 아니라 '암기(rote)' 학습을 줄여야 한다는 맥락이므로 부적절 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 암기식 사실 학습 강조를 줄여야 한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
① asking questions: 학교가 늘려야 할 것 → 줄일 강조와 반대
② obtaining the right answer: 본문에서 강조 지양 대상이나 빈칸 문맥과 불일치
③ rote learning of facts: 본문에서 학교가 줄여야 한다고 명시된 표현 ←정답
④ creative investigation: 다른 맥락의 표현

questions.passage: Society makes a pedagogical mistake when it emphasizes obtaining the so-called "right answer" rather than asking the "right" question, or at least, a good question. The so-called "good student" is viewed as the one who rapidly provides the right answers to questions teachers ask. On this view, the expert in a given field unfortunately becomes an extension of the so-called "expert student" — the one who knows and can quickly spit back a lot of information. As John Dewey believed, how one thinks about issues often is more important and consequential in life than exactly what one thinks. Schools should teach students how to ask important questions (questions that are worth answering and that are interesting) and reduce their emphasis on rote learning of facts. And they need to reorient their emphases in diverse domains, __________. Contemporary creativity research embraces a wide variety of distinct domains, from science to engineering to business to architectural design to the arts to athletics, all of which are ready for creative investigation.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 예술 분야뿐만 아니라 다양한 영역에서라는 맥락
det.analysis:
① from science to engineering: 이후 열거의 일부 표현이나 빈칸 위치에 부적합
② not just in the arts: 예술에만 국한되지 않는다는 의미로, '다양한 영역에서 강조점 재조정' 맥락을 완성 ←정답
③ a wide variety of distinct domains: 창의성 연구 서술 절의 표현으로 위치 불일치
④ ready for creative investigation: 관계절의 서술어 부분으로 문맥 불일치
det.tip: not just A = A뿐만 아니라 (= not only A)
